name: Aircraft Radar

descriptions.en_US: Live aircraft around a point you choose, on one key or a 2x2 block of keys, with a list of the nearest flights. The nearest aircraft are colored and listed over a dim world map outline. Data comes from community ADS-B (and MLAT) receivers via api.adsb.lol; the map outline is Natural Earth 1:10m. No API key is needed and all radar keys share a single poll.
